parsed.notes: Actual ratios are not disclosed. Limits were set by the Waiver and Third Amendment of September 16, 2026. Future limits step as follows: FCCR minimum 1.00x through 3/31/2027, 1.10x at 6/30/2027, and 1.25x from 9/30/2027. Senior cash flow leverage maximum 6.75x at 12/31/2026, 6.25x at 3/31/2027, 3.50x at 6/30/2027, and 3.00x from 9/30/2027. The company breached its financial covenants at 12/31/2025, 3/31/2026 and 6/30/2026 and received waivers for each. Senior cash flow leverage is the borrower Tulp 24.1's senior-debt leverage; the facility is secured, so it is classed as 'other' rather than 'secured_leverage'. The Unadjusted EBITDA-based leverage ratio applies only to the interest margin grid and is excluded.
